chunks: Ink is an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain built on the OP Stack, positioned as the house of DeFi for the Superchain, unleashed by Kraken. 1-second block times on day one (sub-second coming), sequencer-level security protecting users from malicious intents, and a commitment to capital flow across the Superchain. Source: https://inkonchain.com/builders

Building on Ink: live testnet (Ink Sepolia) with a faucet for test ETH; standard Ethereum tooling (Foundry, Hardhat, Remix); quickstart, network details, and contract addresses at the DevDocs. RPC: https://rpc-gel.inkonchain.com. Source: https://docs.inkonchain.com/

On Sep 14, 2026 sergio (@cruelhandeth) announced V1 of the @Quotrons404 builder registry live on @inkonchain, and that he and @KurtG are building an ecosystem-wide permissionless builder program for teams and indie devs looking for funding. Source: https://x.com/cruelhandeth/status/2099585522058350965

Kurt (@KurtG) quote-posted sergio's announcement the same day: serious builders should reach out — 'IWO (ink world order) has only just begun. there is no better place to build, welcome to the new frontier.' Source: https://x.com/kurtg/status/2099586205109125132

Program contacts: @kurtg is the lead dev community principal (primary coordination contact); @cruelhandeth is the ecosystem lead (strategic direction; limited bandwidth for day-to-day dev interaction). Kraken is preparing formal promotion of the Ink builder ecosystem. Source: UZE proposal docs/INK-BUILDER-PROGRAM-PROPOSAL.md

Proposal in flight (DRAFT, 2026-10-15): James (456 Innovation Partners / UZE), Nithin Mengani, and Jonathan Schmidt propose to build and operate the Ink ecosystem-wide permissionless builder program — permissionless entry, Teams and Indie-dev lanes, flagship track on frontier NFT security paired with open finance. Asks: Ink/Kraken recognition, coordination with KurtG, and a seed funding pool. Source: UZE repo docs/INK-BUILDER-PROGRAM-PROPOSAL.md
